about: The closed values of `check --strict --json` that runward-fleet's decision reading is keyed on (ADR-0125, docs/spec/runward-fleet-decision.md). `published` lists the values the runward package published on npm writes; `unreleased` the values only the CLI of this tree writes. Values are only ever added (ADR-0030). test/unit/fleet-decision.test.js holds this file against the CLI of this tree, read from its code, and requires a sentence for every value, in both languages of the lexicon.

published.read: 2026-11-10, the tarball from the registry, its integrity compared with the line above: every place that sets a value of these fields in dist/lib/check-contract.js (conformanceEntries, machinePayload), conformance.js (conformance, driftReport, charterActGaps, ratificationRows, ledgerMode, GATED_DELIVERABLES), evidence.js, verdict.js, delegation.js and mission.js (PHASES, artifactState, inProgressCause)

phase.field: deliverables[].phaseId and conformance[].phaseId (null for a scope that is not a phase)

index.about: The values runward-fleet adds when it builds runward-fleet-index/0 (docs/spec/runward-fleet-index.md): the reading has a sentence for each too.

mission.about: The values runward-fleet's mission projections add (ADR-0126, docs/spec/runward-fleet-mission.md): the six steps and the phases each holds, the gated scope that names a refusal's phase in an index written before refusals carried their phaseId, how a step reads, why a step is complete and not crossed, the state of a check received that writes none, and the holes of a series. Every phase of lists.phase is on exactly one step, and every value here has a sentence in both languages of the lexicon: test/unit/fleet-mission.test.js holds this section against ui/mission.js.
